draft.emotion: respectful and slightly cautious, acknowledging someone who holds authority over your time
notes: Use 'el jefe' for a man and 'la jefa' for a woman.
In informal Mexican Spanish, 'mi jefe' and 'mi jefa' are also very commonly used to mean 'my dad' and 'my mom'.
